cohort.source_population: fixed local PubChem candidate subpool; exclusion and positional-anchor gates applied before model results
cohort.export_selection: canonical plus the two numerically smallest frozen rewrite IDs; no outcome-based selection

index_conventions.canonical_atom_indices: 0-based atom order in the frozen canonical SMILES graph; corresponding 1-based numbers also provided
index_conventions.character_spans: 0-based half-open [start,end); also 1-based inclusive [start+1,end]. Original inputs are ASCII, so character and UTF-8 byte offsets agree.
index_conventions.token_indices: 0-based positions in the exact model input including CLS and SEP; matching 1-based positions also provided
index_conventions.special_tokens: CLS is token index 0; SEP is the last token; special tokens have raw offset [0,0] and are not assigned to atoms
index_conventions.missing: null means unavailable/not represented. Numerical zero is retained only when it is an actual stored activation or prediction.
index_conventions.mapper_span_caveat: The frozen mapper complete-span relation refers to its assigned model tokens. It does not imply that brackets or hydrogen attributes are preserved; per-character coverage and lost_attributes are reported separately.

measurement.units: native, unnormalised post-GELU activation; no rounding or averaging
measurement.measured_values: archived trained-model float32 atom-anchor coefficients, exported as JSON numbers without recomputation

prediction.name: frozen development-only bonding-environment rule
prediction.source_fit: results/artwork/examples/Fig5d_CID66277342_three_SMILES.json#/prediction (released frozen lookup values; archived predictor hash retained in provenance)
prediction.backoff: radius 1 key -> radius 0 key -> development global mean
prediction.two_prediction_values_per_atom: one frozen bonding-environment prediction for neuron 293 and one for neuron 454; not two newly fitted rules

highlighted_site_from_figure_5a_edit.definition: carbon adjacent to the terminal hydroxyl oxygen selected by the frozen OH-to-H edit; not selected by activation magnitude
